gloss: advance payment; prepayment; payment in advance

definitions.gloss: advance payment; prepayment; payment in advance
definitions.explanation: Paying for goods or services before they are delivered or rendered. A common payment arrangement in Japanese commerce and daily life.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}は{先払|さきばら}いです。
{家賃|やちん}は{毎月|まいつき}{先払|さきばら}いで{支払|しはら}う。
examples.english: Rent is paid in advance each month.

examples.japanese: ネットショッピングでは{先払|さきばら}いと{後払|あとばら}いのどちらかを{選|えら}べることが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: When shopping online, you can often choose between advance payment and pay-later options.

notes:
Common in restaurants (especially ramen shops and fast-food), vending machine purchases, and online shopping. Many Japanese restaurants use ticket machines ({食券|しょっけん}{機|き}) that operate on a {先払|さきばら}い system.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {先払|さきばら}い{制|せい}: prepayment system
- {先払|さきばら}いで: by advance payment
- {料金|りょうきん}{先払|さきばら}い: prepaid fee
- {先払|さきばら}いチャージ: prepaid charge

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {後払|あとばら}い: deferred payment; pay later — the opposite; paying after receiving goods or services
- {前払|まえばら}い: prepayment — very similar; {前払|まえばら}い is more common in accounting and formal business contexts
- {代金引換|だいきんひきかえ}: cash on delivery (COD) — paying at the time of delivery
